declarations.doc: Native collision escape law.** Every finite coordinate-relative valuation prefix contains the depth-`n` carrier and neutral depth-zero carrier, but the same-prime component of their native Dirichlet convolution is exactly the next carrier and lies outside the prefix field.

declarations.name: arithmeticOfPrimePowerColumn_mul_apply_distinct_unequal

declarations.name: suzukiWienerEval_discreteConv
declarations.doc: Evaluation turns discrete convolution into multiplication.** One factor is `ℓ¹`, the other finitely supported: this is Suzuki's situation, where the prime block is a finite atom sum.
